summary: Frontend-only verification of DSKos (branch conflict_091026_1738) at https://kos-build-preview.preview.emergentagent.com/ on 390x844. BLOCKING BUG FOUND & FIXED: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx was the Emergent scaffold placeholder rendering a static 'Start building apps on emergent' image, which took precedence over app/(tabs)/index.tsx in Expo Router — so the DSKos app never rendered at '/'. Removed the stray file; app now boots to Beranda. After the fix all 7 requested smoke flows pass end-to-end: (1) Home screen testID home-screen with greeting 'Selamat datang 👋', PIN banner, income/expense/net card, 4 stat tiles, Aksi Cepat row, Jatuh Tempo + Belum Bayar + Pembayaran Terakhir, and 4-tab bar (Beranda/Kamar/Penghuni/Keuangan). (2) Kamar: created A1 (Rp 1.000.000) via rooms-add-fab + room-save-button, no error. (3) Penghuni: created tenant Budi TEST / 08123456789 with room A1 assigned via tenant-room-1 chip and tenant-save-button, navigates to tenant detail. (4) Catat Bayar: quick-pay → payment-form picks payment-tenant-1 which auto-fills Rp 1.000.000, payment-save-button → Kuitansi screen KW/202610/0001 Budi TEST / A1 / Oktober 2026 / Tunai / Rp 1.000.000 / LUNAS badge. (5) THERMAL PRINTER on receipt (receipt-thermal-button): clicking triggers graceful red toast 'Cetak thermal hanya tersedia di aplikasi Android (APK)' — NO crash, NO Bluetooth permission exception, matches thermal.ts line 76/83 web guard. (6) Pengaturan > Printer Thermal (printer-settings card): paper-width segmented 58/80 visible, 'Belum ada printer dipilih' text correct. Switching to 80 mm and reloading persists via storage (s80 button retains selected background color — savePaperWidth → storage.setItem works on web). Clicking Pilih Printer Bluetooth (printer-select-button) + Tes Cetak (printer-test-button) each show the SAME graceful 'Cetak thermal hanya tersedia di aplikasi Android (APK)' toast — no crash. (7) Backup: settings-export-share triggers a real browser download 'kosmanager-backup-20261009-1539.json'; settings-import button renders without crash (not fully invoked). No PAGEERROR captured anywhere in the run. Only harmless RN-web warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (library-level), 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated', 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' (fallback to JS). The Android native BLUETOOTH_SCAN permission crash fix (modules/bt-printer Kotlin + app.json android.blockedPermissions=['android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN'] + thermal.ts ensurePermission requesting ONLY BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) cannot be verified in web preview and must be validated on a real Android APK build.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent scaffold placeholder file was left in the repo and overrode app/(tabs)/index.tsx. The entire DSKos app was invisible on '/' before fix — root rendered only the static app-image.png 'Start building apps on emergent' image. FIXED by deleting /app/frontend/app/index.tsx so the (tabs) group becomes the root route.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-fatal; comes from IntroSplash (<Animated.View pointerEvents="none">) and the generated Stack content wrapper. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/IntroSplash.tsx:20.
RN-web warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode'. Non-fatal, was coming from the stale app/index.tsx (now deleted); verify no other Image uses style.resizeMode.

Native BLUETOOTH_SCAN permission crash fix (thermal.ts ensurePermission requests only BLUETOOTH_CONNECT; app.json android.blockedPermissions blocks BLUETOOTH_SCAN; comment 'we use already-paired devices and never scan') cannot be validated on web — needs an EAS/APK build against a real Android >= 12 device to confirm the toast 'Need android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN permission ... cancelDiscovery' no longer appears.

action_items: Re-run Emergent Publish to produce a new APK and verify the original screenshot error ('Need android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN permission ... AdapterService cancelDiscovery') is gone when tapping Pilih Printer / Tes Cetak in Pengaturan > Printer Thermal on a real Android 12+ device.
critical_code_review_comments: app/index.tsx (now deleted) was a leftover Emergent template file — ensure future imports strip this scaffold or the (tabs)/_layout.tsx takes clear priority.

thermal.ts correctly guards web with printerSupported() and throws a user-facing Indonesian message; showPrintError catches BtPermissionError and offers Linking.openSettings() for blocked permissions on Android — good UX.
modules/bt-printer/index.ts uses requireOptionalNativeModule so BtPrinter is undefined on web and Expo Go — printerSupported() correctly short-circuits before any native call.
src/db/client.web.ts uses in-memory sql.js and resets per browser session — acceptable for native target but worth a one-line note in README for web preview users to avoid confusion.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows pass after removing stray index.tsx)

seed_data_creation: Per-session sql.js seed: Room A1 (Rp 1.000.000), Tenant 'Budi TEST' (room A1, phone 08123456789), Payment KW/202610/0001 Rp 1.000.000 LUNAS periode 2026-10. In Pengaturan: paper width toggled 58→80 (persisted across reload).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date 2026-10-09. If the DSKos app ever renders only the dark 'Start building apps on emergent' image at '/', re-check whether a stray app/index.tsx got re-introduced that overrides app/(tabs)/index.tsx. Mobile viewport 390x844 mandatory; cold start ~25-35s for Metro + sql.js wasm; title should be 'DSKos'. Web guard for thermal printer lives in /app/frontend/src/thermal.ts (printerSupported() → Platform.OS==='android' && !!BtPrinter) — on web it throws 'Cetak thermal hanya tersedia di aplikasi Android (APK)' which is captured by showPrintError and displayed as a red toast. The native Android BLUETOOTH_SCAN fix (modules/bt-printer Kotlin, app.json android.blockedPermissions, ensurePermission requesting only BLUETOOTH_CONNECT) is untestable on web preview — needs real APK + Android 12+ device.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE of 'app does not open' blocking: Expo Router prefers an explicit file-based route over a group route, so /app/frontend/app/index.tsx (the Emergent scaffold showing only app-image.png) silently masked /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (the real DSKos Beranda). Fix: delete /app/frontend/app/index.tsx. Verified by rendering the full Beranda with testID home-screen after `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`.
